cities.name: Stockholm
cities.local_food_tip: Try Swedish classics — fish dishes, pastries, light café meals and local breads — great for exploring city by foot and sea air.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🌅 Walk through the historic old town, visit old streets, enjoy sea‑view promenades. → 🖼️ Visit museums or galleries showcasing local art and history. → ☕ Coffee and pastry stop in a cozy city café.

Afternoon: 🚤 Boat trip to nearby islands or coastal archipelago for sea breeze and water views. → 🍽️ Lunch: local dishes with Scandinavian flavours. → 🚶 Stroll along waterfront or urban districts.

Sunset: 🌇 Sea‑view or rooftop panorama for sunset over water and city. 

Night: 🌃 Dining in local restaurants, relaxed strolls — mix of history, water and modern vibe.

ideas: 🌸 Waterfront and parks bloom — perfect for walks and nature+city mix.
🚤 Early boat rides to islands before summer crowds.
🎨 Cultural events, open‑air markets and light dinners in spring sun.
🏖️ Sea‑side walks, archipelago trips and daylight‑long exploring.
🍨 Light meals, outdoor cafés, ice cream and relaxed summer nights.
🎶 Street‑music or cultural events by waterfront under long days.
🍂 Autumn light over water and old town — beautiful for photos.
🧣 Warm local dishes, cosy cafés after walks as weather cools.
🏛️ Museum visits and indoor culture on rainy or crisp days.
❄️ Snow or frost over historic streets and waterfront — magical mood.
🔥 Hot drinks, warm food, cozy indoor spots after chilly outdoor time.
🌌 Evening strolls under winter lights — peaceful city atmosphere.

public_transport_tips: 🚋 Use metro, trams, buses or boats — great network for islands/coast + city.
🚶 Historic centre and waterfront are walkable — ideal for exploring on foot.
🎟️ Consider passes if using many transports/boats in a day.
🛶 For water‑trips — boat tickets or tours recommended especially in high season.

city_events.name: Stockholm Summer Archipelago Days
city_events.description: 🚤 Boat trips, island visits, sea‑side walks and city‑water celebrations.

cities.name: Uppsala (Inland & History)
cities.local_food_tip: Local bakery goods, traditional Swedish meals, local breads and comfort dishes — ideal after walking old streets or riverside paths.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏛️ Walk through old town centre and visit historic buildings (cathedral, old university area). → ☕ Breakfast or pastry in a local café.

Afternoon: 🌳 Stroll along the river or explore botanical gardens/natural zones nearby → 🍽️ Lunch: simple Swedish meal with local produce.

Sunset: 🌇 Riverside or city‑edge walk — peaceful views and calm atmosphere. 

Night: 🌙 Quiet dinner, cozy cafés or relaxed evening strolls — small‑town charm meets history.

ideas: 🌼 Blossoms, gentle riverside walks and soft weather for sightseeing.
📚 Cultural walks through historic sites and old town alleys.
☀️ Outdoor cafés and relaxed city atmosphere.
🚶 Early morning or late evening riverside walks to avoid summer crowds.
🍽️ Outdoor lunches or picnics with local food and calm atmosphere.
🌳 Quiet small‑city vibes with mild weather and relaxed pace.
🍂 Fall colours along streets and riverbanks — great for photos and relaxing walks.
🔥 Warm meals and cozy cafés after crisp autumn days.
🏛️ Museums or indoor heritage visits if weather changes.
❄️ Snow‑covered streets and soft winter ambiance in small city setting.
🔥 Hot drinks, warm food, cozy dinners and calm indoor culture spots.
🌙 Evening walks under soft winter lights — peaceful and atmospheric.

public_transport_tips: 🚶 Town centre is compact — explore mostly on foot.
🚆 Regional trains/buses connect with larger cities if planning day‑trips.
🚲 Bike or walk for nearby nature/riverside paths — convenient and scenic.
📝 Check schedules for public transport if exploring outskirts or countryside.

city_events.name: Uppsala Historical & Nature Days
city_events.description: 🏛️ Heritage tours, riverside walks and community events in historic town setting.
